_doc: Boat radio stations (R cycles; off is after the last). hours = [from, to] when the station is on air (wraps midnight), otherwise you hear static. voice: calm | voice | hymn | numbers | song | static. Lines may require (if) or exclude (ifNot) a story flag, or require heat (minHeat), so broadcasts change as the world changes. sets: line index → flag raised when heard.

lines.text: This is Highmark Official. Chancellor Idris Calloway wishes every vessel a safe and orderly day.
Ration collection for the Orrin Bay districts is on the third day. Have your tally and your wristband ready.
Work permits are available to raft-born who demonstrate reliable labour. Yellow is a colour of trust.
Tide Ward vessels operate for your protection. Please comply with inspections promptly.
There is no evidence of renewed illness. Keeping two arms apart remains a courtesy.
Reports of lights in the deep water are settling structures and marine phosphorescence. There is no cause for concern.
A brief fault interrupted the Beacon overnight. Engineers have resolved it. There is no cause for concern.
Smuggling endangers supply for everyone. Report unregistered craft to any Ward vessel.
Order and supply. Supply and order. Highmark is with you.
Free Voice, broadcasting from a raft that isn't on any Ward chart. Hello, Drift.
Portage prices this week: kelp cheap, sealed tins dear. Greentide's practically giving greens away. Rusthold fuel's the fairest in the Wreck.
Highmark says the ration is steady. Count your bars. Then count your neighbours.
Somebody on Low Row lost their whole house in a storm last year. If it happens again, throw a line. That's all any of us has.
The Ward had a boat out past Portage last night with its engine baffled. Listen harder than you look.
We heard a diver went to the Sounding. Whatever you heard down there, tell us. We'll say it out loud so you don't have to.
♪ Lay the lamp upon the water, let the water judge the flame ♪
The Keeper says: the tide does not hate. It weighs.
♪ What we gave the deep, the deep remembers; what it gives back, it gives by name ♪
Be still tonight. The Deep is listening, and it is not unkind to the still.
[static] ...Lowlight. If you can hear this, you are not alone on the water.
Numbers follow. Write them down.
Nine six. One two eight. Minus. Nine six. One two eight. Minus.
The plaza that fell. Lower the ear at night. Listen to what Highmark listens to.
Wardens on the south lane tonight. Engines off past the Stacks. Marlow says: be dull, be dark, be gone.
Nine six. One two eight. Minus. [static] ...counting down.
Night Songs. Old records, older voices. This is Marisol. Tie up, turn down, stay a while.
♪ Hold the light for me, hold it till I'm home, the sea is wide but it's not as wide as you ♪
A request came in by bottle, if you can believe it. From a diver called Teo. For his little sister, wherever she's tied up tonight. He says: keep the lamp lit. He says he's sorry about the boat.
♪ And if the water rises, and the morning doesn't come, hold the light for me, hold it till I'm home ♪
That's the hour. Sleep dry if you can.
[static]
[static] ...two hundred and twelve... [static]
[static]
[a woman's voice, very far away, says your name. Then static.]
